messages.subject: facet stacked barplot
parts:
I am trying to facet a barplot of proportions and get the strangest
results:

each facet group adds to 100% and I don't get why the plots have
diminishing returns

https://docs.google.com/viewer?a=v&pid=explorer&chrome=true&srcid=0B_fxBzPqiPDyODQyZThiN2ItN2M1MC00ZTgzLWJkYjMtYzEzNTU4YTBjOTZi&hl=en_US

code:

ggplot(final, aes(x=reorder(bird, group*value), y=value,
fill=factor(group))) +geom_bar(stat="identity",
width=0.01)+opts(axis.text.x=theme_text(angle=-90, hjust=0))
+labs(y=paste("K=",length(dat)))+opts(axis.text.y = theme_blank())
+facet_wrap(~K,ncol=1)

messages.subject: Re: facet stacked barplot
parts:
Hi Zev,
Your message was 13,000 lines long, your code referred to a missing
variable 'dat', and it wouldn't run the way it broke across lines.

It will be easier for others to help if you provide a minimal
reproducible example. See http://gist.github.com/270442

I can't tell what you were trying to do from your description but you
should look at http://had.co.nz/ggplot2/geom_bar.html
There are also some good alternatives to barplots shown there. Perhaps
you would be interested in a Cleveland dot plot?
http://learnr.wordpress.com/2009/07/02/ggplot2-version-of-figures-in-lattice-multivariate-data-visualization-with-r-part-4/

The following code modifies an example from ?geom_bar to show a
categorical variable on x with stacked proportions using
position = "fill" and faceting.
-Allan R 2.13.0, x86_64-pc-linux-gnu, ggplot2_0.8.9

# code to make a stacked proportion bar chart with facets
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(mtcars, aes(factor(cyl), fill = factor(gear)), position =
"fill") +
geom_histogram(position = "fill") + facet_wrap( ~ am, ncol = 1)

On Jun 22, 11:53 am, Zev <jewb...@gmail.com> wrote:
> I am trying to facet a barplot of proportions and get the strangest
> results:
>
> each facet group adds to 100% and I don't get why the plots have
> diminishing returns
>

>
> code:
>
> ggplot(final, aes(x=reorder(bird, group*value), y=value,
> fill=factor(group))) +geom_bar(stat="identity",
> width=0.01)+opts(axis.text.x=theme_text(angle=-90, hjust=0))
> +labs(y=paste("K=",length(dat)))+opts(axis.text.y = theme_blank())
> +facet_wrap(~K,ncol=1)
>
> > final
